svg.aria-label: Isolated comparison of box fills, today against the proposed grey scale
svg.text: A or A + widened fills: the one open question
Settled: B adds nothing over A; F and G detach the name of the technology from its image; C's accent is kept, and appears on both sides below.
What remains is the fill of the boxes. On the seven-row sheet, E differed from A in two ways at once and the rows were far apart: impossible to judge. Here the content is identical to the pixel.
Top row: today. Bottom row: proposed. The ratio is the contrast with white — a tinted fill that stays below 1.09:1 claims to separate without separating.
2. The same fragment, only the fills change
The same two, blurred: what is left when you can no longer read. What survives here is what shows at first glance.
My view: today's fills separate the actor from the service by 1.054:1, which is nothing at all. The question is not whether to widen them, but by how much.
Nothing is applied: the views in the repository still use the fills of the top row. Sheet generated by scripts/specimen-fills.mjs.
